W3Schools offers example-based coding tutorials with an interactive editor. Scrimba focuses on front-end development with a project-first approach. Codewars provides gamified coding challenges. Harvard’s CS50 is a free course on computer science basics. Coursera offers various beginner coding courses, including those from the University of California, Santa Cruz, and Princeton University. FreeCodeCamp, Codecademy, and Khan Academy provide interactive coding courses. Repl.it, Sololearn, Grasshopper, and Codecademy offer additional interactive and engaging coding tutorials. The Coding Train YouTube channel features tutorials on Processing and p5.js.
